handback.title: A new install clears the old Dokima copies
handback.summary: Installing Dokima removes the old copied Dokima code and workflows, so they stop running.
handback.user_story: After a new install, the sandbox holds no old Dokima code or workflows, so only the new install runs.

acceptance_criteria.text: When Dokima is installed over an old install, the old copy of Dokima's code is gone from the repo.
acceptance_criteria.words: The sandbox already holds the old copied Dokima code and workflows; a new install leaves them there, still running.

edge_cases.case: The repo's own files beside the old copy, like its README, are kept unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.text: When Dokima is installed over an old install, the new workflow is the only Dokima workflow left.
acceptance_criteria.words: The sandbox already holds the old copied Dokima code and workflows; a new install leaves them there, still running.

edge_cases.case: The repo's own workflow, not one of Dokima's, is kept unchanged.
